review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Mandatory requirement: We need someone with hands-on experience designing and managing software-defined virtual private networks — specifically Tailscale or a comparable WireGuard-based mesh VPN — to run and harden our fleet network connecting multiple remote sites to a central hub.
